bondage.line: Sister, forgive your man that he may rise from bondage
stanza: Men, respect your sister and respect your Queen
Be good to your woman and she will free you
Sister, forgive your man that he may rise from bondage
Only you, my Queen, can free the man

bondage.line: Beyond the moment that ends our bondage
stanza: Below this, we'll end here until the end of time
Beyond the moment that ends our bondage
I am your failed husband contender
I'm your loan shark of bliss
